description: Additional city enabled through a shared verified provider without changing canonical parcel IDs.
identity: Same provider-native key and prefix used by every city served by this source. City is a viewport entry, not part of parcel identity.
scope: Bounded city entry only; no whole-country live coverage claim.
routing: Ambiguous parcel prefixes are resolved by exact geometry through the repository’s read-only locateIds; lookup cannot publish ground into the wrong city repository.
